## Overview
Unit tests for the Birko.Rules project — data-driven rule engine.

## Project Location
- `tests/Birko.Rules.Tests/`

## Dependencies
- **Birko.Rules** (shared project via .projitems)
- xUnit 2.9.3
- FluentAssertions 7.0.0

## Test Classes
- **RuleTests** — Core types: Rule, RuleGroup, RuleSet, RuleResult construction and defaults
- **ContextTests** — DictionaryRuleContext and ObjectRuleContext (TryGetValue, HasField, null handling, case-insensitivity)
- **RuleEvaluatorTests** — Full evaluator coverage: all comparison operators, negation, disabled rules, AND/OR groups, nested groups, RuleSet evaluation, EvaluateAll/EvaluateMatches
- **RuleExpressionConverterTests** — LINQ expression conversion: all operators, value type coercion, nested properties with null guards, AND/OR groups, negation, RuleSet, disabled rules, case-insensitive property names
- **Task881RuleEvaluatorNullTests** — TASK-864's NULL shapes (plus null bounds) x plain / negated / NOT group, `RuleEvaluator` on typed and dictionary contexts vs the compiled rule (C#)
- **Task882RuleLeftoversTests** — TASK-882's shapes (`tests/Shared/StoreContract/RuleLeftoverShapes.cs`, linked: null against non-nullable members, `Like`, values as text) x plain / negated / NOT group, the compiled rule and `RuleEvaluator` (typed and dictionary contexts) vs the C# lambda; an interior `%` refused by every runner
- **Task882RuleValueAndPatternTests** — `RuleLikePattern` (anchors, OrdinalIgnoreCase match, refusal by field) and `RuleValueConverter` (enum / Guid / date / number conversion, unconvertible values, fractions)

## Running Tests
```bash
dotnet test Birko.Rules.Tests/Birko.Rules.Tests.csproj
```

## Maintenance
When adding new functionality to Birko.Rules, add corresponding tests here.
